QuestInfo.name: Mission in Perion
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1101002##k told me there's an item that I'll need to deliver that is crucial to this upcoming assignment.
QuestInfo.1: #p1101002# wound up giving me #t4032145#. He told me I'll soon discover the reason for the item and asked me to deliver #t4032145# to #bAgent #p1103004##k of #b#m102000000##k.

0.0: You're here. Unlike other assignments, this one will start here. That's why I have asked you to come all the way to Ereve.
0.1: Your assignment is to deliver an item. You must take #t4032145# and deliver it to #bAgent #p1103004##k somewhere in #b#m102000000##k.

yes.0: After the delivery, #p1103004# will brief you on the rest of your assignment. You will know where #t4032145# will be used later on.

no.0: Now that you're in Ereve, do you have some unfinished business to take care of? If so, then I'll just wait for you.

1.0: You're one of those rookie Knights, right? Your name is... #h0#? I heard a lot about you through #p1103001#, #p1103002#, and #p1103003#. Nice to meet you, my name is Agent #p1103004#, and #m102000000# is my district. Weird name, right? I named myself after the residents of #m102000000# in hopes of blending in, and... that's what happened.

yes.0: Ah, so this is the #t4032145# that #p1101002# was talking about. Before starting the mission, I must start #t4032145# first. Please wait for a minute.

npc.0: You haven't met #b#p1103004##k yet? She is stationed at #b#m102000000##k. She won't be hard to find.

item.0: ...Eh... Haven't I seen you somewhere before...? Anyway, #b#p1101002##k told me you'll be giving me #b#t4032145##k...
